Diversity of provision is a strength: specialist training, single, combined and interdisciplinary courses, from industry-ready to research-led and socially engaged
Embodied and experiential learning is its distinctive way of knowing

subjectSpecific.text: You will take part in performing and producing work, built on learning the vocabularies, skills and methods of your field.
You will develop techniques that come from, or are shaped by, particular cultures, histories or practitioners.
You will describe, theorise, interpret and judge performance texts and events from different points of view, using the subject's language.
You will find and analyse historical sources.
You will analyse what performance does in social, cultural and political debate, past and present.
You will plan, lead, run and evaluate projects that use participatory performance in community, educational and social settings.
You will deal with the ethical questions that performance raises.
By the end of your master's degree, you should be able to show a systematic, thorough and critical grasp of where practice and research in your field are now and where they are going.
By the end of your master's degree, you should be able to evaluate current research and advanced scholarship and use what you know in original ways.
By the end of your master's degree, you should be able to complete a major piece of practice or a substantial research project, built on a thorough understanding of your discipline.

transferable.text: You will take charge of managing projects and making creative decisions, on your own or in a group.
You will research and evaluate information, reach your own judgements and make reasoned arguments.
You will work with others in academic, creative and professional settings to set and reach shared goals.
You will consider, recognise and respect different opinions, experiences and performance traditions.
You will write in the right academic and professional styles for the task.
You will present information in different forms to suit the content, the audience and the setting.
By the end of your master's degree, you should be able to weigh up methods and tackle complex problems in practice or research on your own initiative and in original ways.
By the end of your master's degree, you should be able to create new insight in your field and explain your conclusions clearly to experts and non-experts.

statements.about: collaboration towards shared goals
statements.paraphrase: Will work with others in intellectual, creative and professional settings to set and pursue shared goals.

forPractitioner.text: Build collaboration into intellectual, creative and professional tasks, with shared goals.

forBeneficiary.text: You will work with others in academic, creative and professional settings to set and reach shared goals.

statements.appliesTo: students of Performance
statements.about: respect for diverse views and traditions
statements.paraphrase: Will consider, recognise and respect different opinions, experiences and performance traditions.

forPractitioner.text: Create space where students engage respectfully with different views, experiences and traditions.

forBeneficiary.text: You will consider, recognise and respect different opinions, experiences and performance traditions.

statements.appliesTo: students of Performance
statements.about: scholarly and professional writing
statements.paraphrase: Will write in fitting scholarly and professional registers and conventions.

forPractitioner.text: Teach and assess writing in both scholarly and professional registers.

forBeneficiary.text: You will write in the right academic and professional styles for the task.

statements.appliesTo: students of Performance
statements.about: presenting information in suitable forms
statements.paraphrase: Will present information in a range of forms suited to content, audience and context.

forPractitioner.text: Assess presentation in several forms, fitted to content, audience and setting.

forBeneficiary.text: You will present information in different forms to suit the content, the audience and the setting.

statements.appliesTo: students taking Performance modules in any course
statements.about: the same outcomes for all students on Performance modules
statements.paraphrase: Whatever course they belong to, students on Performance modules or pathways are held to the same learning outcomes.

forPractitioner.text: Hold students on Performance modules to the same outcomes whatever their course: single, joint, combined, major-minor or general.

forBeneficiary.text: Whatever course you are on, if you take Performance modules you are held to the same learning outcomes as everyone else on them.

statements.appliesTo: all students of Performance
statements.about: subject growth and progression for all Performance students; capstone
statements.paraphrase: Everyone studying Performance will build subject knowledge or skills with matching experience, and that study will support progress in expertise, personal and social growth and intellectual maturity; courses often end in a capstone project, and non-specialists may not reach the same depth.

forPractitioner.text: Plan for every Performance student, specialist or not, to build subject knowledge or skill and grow personally and intellectually; a final-year capstone is common, and depth may differ for students whose main subject lies elsewhere.

forBeneficiary.text: However you study Performance, you will build knowledge or skills in it and grow personally, socially and intellectually, often finishing with a major final-year project.

statements.appliesTo: teaching, learning and assessment in the subject
statements.about: inclusion, access and reasonable adjustments built in
statements.paraphrase: A commitment to diversity, inclusion and accessibility will underpin teaching, learning and assessment, and design, delivery and assessment will have flexibility built in so that reasonable adjustments can be made for individual needs.

forPractitioner.text: Build diversity, inclusion and access into teaching, learning and assessment, and design in the flexibility needed to make reasonable adjustments for individual learning needs.

forBeneficiary.text: Your teaching and assessment will be built on a commitment to diversity, inclusion and access, with room to make reasonable adjustments for your learning needs.

statements.appliesTo: teaching and learning in the subject
statements.about: teaching drawn from the disciplines' practice
statements.paraphrase: Teaching and learning will rest on methods that suit and belong to the different disciplines within Performance.

forPractitioner.text: Choose teaching and learning activities from the working methods of the disciplines you teach: dance, drama, theatre and related practice.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a duty on those who design teaching; it sets no outcome for the student

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject
statements.about: learning in practical and professional contexts, in varied roles
statements.paraphrase: Students will usually learn in or alongside practical and professional Performance settings, taking on roles suited to their subject and joining processes from first research through creative work, rehearsal and production to performance.

forPractitioner.text: Give students learning in or near practical and professional settings, where they will take varied roles across the whole process from research to performance.

forBeneficiary.text: You will usually learn in practical and professional settings, take on different roles and work through the whole process from early research to rehearsal, production and performance.

statements.appliesTo: students of the subject
statements.about: tutor-led to independent learning; group work
statements.paraphrase: Students will typically meet both tutor-led and self-directed learning, becoming more independent and autonomous as they move through the levels, which builds a positive attitude to lifelong learning; group work is a common feature.

forPractitioner.text: Mix tutor-led and self-directed learning and shift the balance towards independence as students move up the levels; group work is a typical part of the course.

forBeneficiary.text: You will usually learn both with tutors and on your own, becoming more independent as you go, and you will often work in groups.

statements.appliesTo: teaching and learning in the subject
statements.about: a balance of settings, in person and online
statements.paraphrase: Learning and teaching will normally happen in varied and changing settings, face to face and online, balancing workshops, rehearsals, productions, practical and studio classes, screenings, lectures, seminars and tutorials.

forPractitioner.text: Offer a suitable mix of settings, in person and online: workshops, rehearsals, productions, studio and practical classes, screenings, lectures, seminars and tutorials.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a duty on those who plan teaching; it sets no outcome for the student

statements.appliesTo: assessment in the subject
statements.about: self and peer assessment for learning
statements.paraphrase: Courses should give students chances to assess their own and each other's work, as support for learning.

forPractitioner.text: Build in self- and peer-assessment tasks that support learning, with clear guidance on how they work.

forBeneficiary.text: You should get chances to assess your own work and your classmates' work, to help you learn.

statements.appliesTo: course information
statements.about: feedback, support and resources in course information
statements.paraphrase: Course information should also set out feedback arrangements, academic and pastoral tutorial support, online resources and access, and reading and viewing lists.

forPractitioner.text: Add to the course information how feedback works, what academic and pastoral tutoring is offered, what online resources exist and how to reach them, and reading and screening lists.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a duty on the course team in writing course information

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance
statements.about: three rungs shown at the award of honours
statements.paraphrase: The standards set out the minimum, typical and excellent achievement a student will have shown on being awarded an honours degree in Performance; showing them over time indicates the expected range of knowledge, understanding and skills.

forPractitioner.text: Read the three rungs as what students will have shown at award: minimum, typical and excellent; design assessment so that students show them over time, not in a single task.

forBeneficiary.text: When you are awarded your honours degree, you will have shown at least the minimum standard, and showing these standards over time shows the range of what you know and can do.

statements.appliesTo: institutions and honours students in Performance
statements.about: most exceed the threshold; Annex D for classification evidence
statements.paraphrase: Most students will do well above the threshold; each institution decides what counts as evidence of that and should refer to Annex D of the qualification frameworks, which describes the four honours classes.

forPractitioner.text: When setting what counts as evidence of achievement, refer to Annex D's descriptions of the four honours classes, expecting most students to perform well above the threshold.

forBeneficiary.text: Most students will do much better than the minimum standard, and your university should judge your work against shared national descriptions of the honours classes.

statements.appliesTo: honours students in Performance
statements.about: what meeting the threshold and excellent work mean
statements.paraphrase: It matters that students know the standards and are pushed and helped past the minimum. They will meet the threshold when, as fits their course, their knowledge, understanding, creativity and skill are enough to present performance or argument on the discipline's skills or materials; excellent work tends to go past the outcomes, with originality, insight, artistic or technical excellence and research of the highest standard.

forPractitioner.text: Make the standards known to students and support them past the minimum. Treat the threshold as met when knowledge, understanding, creativity and skill are enough to present performance, information or argument in the discipline; expect excellent work to exceed the outcomes with originality, insight and artistic or technical excellence.

forBeneficiary.text: You will meet the minimum standard when what you know and can do is enough to present a performance or an argument on your discipline's skills or materials; excellent work goes beyond the set outcomes, with originality, insight and high artistic or technical quality.

statements.appliesTo: all courses in the subject
statements.about: the cross-cutting themes in every course
statements.paraphrase: Every course should build in and advance, as concepts and as practice, access, equality, diversity and inclusion, enterprise and sustainability.

forPractitioner.text: Whatever outcomes your course selects from the indicative list, build access, equality, diversity and inclusion, enterprise and sustainability into both content and practice.

forBeneficiary.text: not-applicable: a duty on those who design courses; it sets no outcome for the student

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: forms, traditions and histories of performance
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to show knowledge of performance's forms, practices, techniques and traditions, its local and global histories and its applications.

forPractitioner.text: Ensure students can show what they know of the art form's forms, practices, techniques and traditions, its histories locally and globally, and its uses.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to show what you know about the forms, practices, techniques and traditions of performance, its histories around the world and how it is used.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: components of performance and how it is made
statements.paraphrase: Should show knowledge of the main components of performance and of how work is made, realised, managed, distributed, received and recorded.

forPractitioner.text: Cover the building blocks of performance and the full life of a work, from creation and management to distribution, audience and documentation.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should know the main parts that make up a performance and how a work is made, managed, shared, watched and recorded.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: critical and theoretical perspectives
statements.paraphrase: Should show knowledge of the critical and theoretical approaches suited to studying the discipline.

forPractitioner.text: Teach the critical and theoretical approaches the discipline uses and check students can show they know them.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should know the main critical and theoretical ways of studying your discipline.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: practitioners, theorists and their contexts
statements.paraphrase: Should show knowledge of practitioners and practices, or theorists, set in their cultural or historical contexts.

forPractitioner.text: Introduce key practitioners, practices or theorists and the cultural and historical settings that shaped them.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should know about practitioners, practices or theorists and the cultural or historical settings they come from.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: role of performance in society, education and industry
statements.paraphrase: Should show knowledge of what performance does and how it works in social, educational, participatory and industry settings.

forPractitioner.text: Show students how performance functions in communities, education, participatory work and the industry.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should know what performance does in society, in education, in participatory work and in the industry.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: interplay of critical and creative enquiry
statements.paraphrase: Should show understanding of how critical and creative ways of enquiring interact in the field.

forPractitioner.text: Help students see how critical study and creative practice feed each other as ways of enquiring.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should understand how thinking critically and making creative work feed into each other.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: interpreting texts and scores to make performance
statements.paraphrase: Should show understanding of how to work with and interpret texts, media, notations or scores in order to make performance.

forPractitioner.text: Teach students to read and interpret scripts, media, notation and scores as material for making performance.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should understand how to read and interpret scripts, media, notation or scores to make performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: group and collective processes
statements.paraphrase: Should show understanding of group and collective ways of working, with their effects and dynamics.

forPractitioner.text: Help students understand how groups and ensembles work, including their dynamics and effects.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should understand how groups and ensembles work, and the effects and dynamics they bring.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: elements of performance
statements.paraphrase: Should show understanding of the key elements of performance in the disciplines, such as source material, performers, space, music, soundscape, text, movement and setting.

forPractitioner.text: Cover the elements performance works with, for example sources, performers, space, sound, text, movement and setting.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should understand the building blocks of performance, such as source material, performers, space, sound, text, movement and setting.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: interdisciplinary elements and their use
statements.paraphrase: Should show understanding of the interdisciplinary elements relevant to performance and how to put them to use.

forPractitioner.text: Introduce the interdisciplinary elements that suit the course and show students how to apply them.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should understand which ideas and methods from across disciplines suit performance, and how to use them.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: knowledge and skills from other disciplines
statements.paraphrase: Should show understanding of knowledge, practices, concepts and skills drawn from other disciplines.

forPractitioner.text: Bring in knowledge, practices, concepts and skills from neighbouring disciplines and check students understand them.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should understand ideas, practices and skills that come from other subjects.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: safe, ethical and sustainable working practice
statements.paraphrase: Should show understanding of performance practitioners' duty to make working practice safe, ethical and environmentally sustainable.

forPractitioner.text: Teach students the duty performance practitioners carry for safe, ethical and environmentally sustainable ways of working.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should understand your duty, as someone who makes performance, to work safely, ethically and sustainably.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: creating or producing performance with the field's vocabularies and methods
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to take part in making or producing performance, drawing on the field's vocabularies, techniques, crafts and technologies, its structures and contexts, and its working and research methods.

forPractitioner.text: Give students repeated practice in making or producing performance with the field's vocabularies, techniques, crafts, technologies and methods.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to make or produce performance using the techniques, crafts, technologies and working methods of your field.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: realising the possibilities of a text, stimulus or score
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to see what a text, stimulus, media, dance notation or score makes possible for performance and, where suitable, realise it through design, technology and performance.

forPractitioner.text: Train students to read a text, stimulus, media, notation or score for its performance possibilities and to realise them in design, technology and performance.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to see what a script, prompt, notation or score could become in performance and bring it to life through design, technology and performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: recording performance through notation or documentation
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to record performance, using notation or documentation skills and technologies.

forPractitioner.text: Teach notation and documentation so students can make records of performance.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to record performance using notation, documentation and the technology for it.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: describing, interpreting and evaluating performance events
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to describe, interpret and evaluate performance events.

forPractitioner.text: Give students practice in describing, interpreting and judging performances they make or see.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to describe, interpret and judge performances.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: independent research into performance
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to carry out independent research, whether into past or present performance or as part of making or responding to it.

forPractitioner.text: Build independent research into the course, both historical study and research within the making of work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to research on your own, whether looking at past or present performance or as part of making or responding to work.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: identifying cultural and contextual frameworks
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to identify the cultural and contextual frameworks within which performance sits.

forPractitioner.text: Help students name the cultural and contextual frameworks around the performance they study and make.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to identify the cultural settings and contexts that frame a performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: spatial relationships in performance environments
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to investigate performance environments and work out what their spatial relationships mean.

forPractitioner.text: Give students tasks that explore performance spaces and what their spatial relationships mean for the work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to explore a performance space and work out what its spatial relationships mean.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: self-management: goals, workload and deadlines
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to manage themselves: setting goals, handling workloads and meeting deadlines.

forPractitioner.text: Give students tasks where they set their own goals, manage workloads and meet deadlines.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to manage yourself: set goals, handle your workload and meet deadlines.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: adaptability and critical awareness of self and others
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to show adaptability, flexibility and a critical awareness of themselves and others.

forPractitioner.text: Create situations that ask students to adapt and to reflect critically on themselves and others.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to adapt, stay flexible and think critically about yourself and others.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: risk management and ethical practice
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to assess and manage risk and work ethically.

forPractitioner.text: Teach risk assessment and ethical working, and expect both in practical work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to assess and manage risk and work ethically.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: critical engagement and argument
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to engage critically, responding with reflexive, creative and critical thought, to develop ideas and build and present arguments suitably.

forPractitioner.text: Ask students to respond reflexively and critically, develop ideas and make and present arguments in fitting forms.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to think critically and reflexively, develop ideas and build and present an argument in a suitable form.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: group and team work on collaborative projects
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to work in a group or team, with the skills to carry out collaborative project work.

forPractitioner.text: Build collaborative projects that call for and assess team skills.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to work in a group or team and have the skills to complete a shared project.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: managing creative, personal and interpersonal issues
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to handle creative, personal and interpersonal relationship issues in creative work.

forPractitioner.text: Support students to manage creative and interpersonal tensions within creative work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to handle creative, personal and interpersonal issues that come up in creative work.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: communication and presentation
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to communicate and present, expressing ideas and information in different forms suited to content and context.

forPractitioner.text: Assess communication in varied forms, matched to content and context.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to communicate and present ideas and information in different forms, suited to what you are saying and to whom.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: information management
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to manage information: finding it, gathering, sifting, judging and organising it.

forPractitioner.text: Teach information skills: finding, gathering, sifting, judging and organising sources.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to find, gather, sift, judge and organise information.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: using digital media and information technology
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to choose, use and adapt digital media and information technologies.

forPractitioner.text: Give students practice in choosing, using and adapting digital tools for their work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to choose, use and adapt digital media and technology.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: project management
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to use project management skills to investigate, organise and carry out activities.

forPractitioner.text: Give students projects they plan, organise and deliver themselves.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to plan, organise and carry out a project.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the threshold rung
statements.about: numeracy for problem-solving and creative outcomes
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to apply suitable numeracy skills to solve problems and achieve creative outcomes.

forPractitioner.text: Build numeracy into practical work, such as budgets, timings and technical calculations.

forBeneficiary.text: At the minimum standard for your honours degree, you should be able to use numbers to solve problems and make creative work happen.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: creative and critical engagement with forms and traditions, problematising them
statements.paraphrase: Should show creative and critical engagement with performance's forms, practices, techniques, traditions, histories and applications, and be able to question them.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to engage creatively and critically with the art form's forms, techniques, traditions and histories, and to problematise them rather than accept them.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should engage creatively and critically with the forms, techniques, traditions and histories of performance, and be able to question them.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: creative and critical engagement with components and making
statements.paraphrase: Should show creative and critical engagement with the main components of performance and with how work is made, realised, managed, distributed and recorded.

forPractitioner.text: Ask students to work creatively and critically with performance's components and with every stage of a work's life.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should work creatively and critically with the parts of a performance and with how a work is made, managed, shared and recorded.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: engaging with critical and theoretical perspectives
statements.paraphrase: Should show engagement with the critical and theoretical approaches suited to studying performance.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to engage with, not only know, the critical and theoretical approaches of the field.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should engage actively with critical and theoretical ways of studying performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: critical understanding of practitioners and contexts
statements.paraphrase: Should show critical understanding of key practitioners, practices or theorists and their cultural or historical settings.

forPractitioner.text: Expect a critical grasp of key practitioners, practices or theorists in their cultural and historical settings.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should understand key practitioners, practices or theorists critically, in their cultural or historical settings.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: engaging with the role of performance in society and industry
statements.paraphrase: Should show creative and critical engagement with how performance functions in social, educational, participatory and industry settings.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to engage creatively and critically with performance's place in communities, education, participation and industry.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should engage creatively and critically with what performance does in society, education, participatory work and the industry.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: strong understanding of critical and creative enquiry
statements.paraphrase: Should show a strong understanding of how critical and creative enquiry interact in the field.

forPractitioner.text: Expect a strong grasp of how critical and creative enquiry work together.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should have a strong understanding of how critical thinking and creative making feed into each other.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: critical interpretation of texts and scores
statements.paraphrase: Should show critical understanding of how to work with and interpret texts, media, notations or scores to make performance.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to interpret scripts, media, notation and scores critically as material for performance.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should understand critically how to read and interpret scripts, media, notation or scores to make performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: creative and critical understanding of group processes
statements.paraphrase: Should show creative and critical understanding of group and collective ways of working.

forPractitioner.text: Expect a creative and critical grasp of how groups and ensembles work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should understand group and ensemble work creatively and critically.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: creative and critical understanding of the elements of performance
statements.paraphrase: Should show creative and critical understanding of the key elements of performance, such as sources, performers, bodies, space, sound, text, movement and setting.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to understand performance's elements creatively and critically, the body included.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should understand the building blocks of performance creatively and critically, including bodies, space, sound, text, movement and setting.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: interdisciplinary elements and drawing on other fields
statements.paraphrase: Should show creative and critical understanding of suitable interdisciplinary elements of performance and how to use ideas, methods and skills taken from other fields.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to understand, creatively and critically, which interdisciplinary elements suit their work and how to draw on other fields.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should understand creatively and critically how ideas, methods and skills from other subjects can be used in performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: critical understanding of safe, sustainable and ethical practice
statements.paraphrase: Should show critical understanding of performance practitioners' duty to make working practice safe, environmentally sustainable and ethical.

forPractitioner.text: Expect a critical grasp of the practitioner's duty to work safely, sustainably and ethically.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should understand critically your duty to work safely, sustainably and ethically when making performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: selecting, refining and presenting performance and production skills
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to work creatively and critically with performance and production skills and processes, choosing, refining and presenting them in performance.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to choose, refine and present performance and production skills with creative and critical judgement.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to work creatively and critically with performance and production skills, choosing, refining and presenting them in your work.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: realising a text or score sensitively
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to work creatively and critically with what a text, stimulus, notation or score offers performance, and where suitable realise it with sensitivity through design and performance.

forPractitioner.text: Expect sensitive, creative and critical realisation of texts, stimuli, notation or scores in design and performance.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to work creatively and critically with what a script, prompt, notation or score offers and bring it to life with sensitivity through design and performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: making performance with a developed grasp of its vocabularies
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to work creatively and critically on making or producing performance, with a developed grasp of suitable vocabularies, techniques, crafts, structures and working methods.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to make or produce work creatively and critically, drawing on a developed command of the field's vocabularies and methods.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to make or produce performance creatively and critically, with a developed grasp of the techniques, crafts and working methods involved.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: creative and critical independent research
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to carry out suitable independent research creatively and critically, whether into past or present performance or within the making of new work.

forPractitioner.text: Expect independent research that is creative and critical, historical or practice-based.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to research on your own creatively and critically, whether into past or present performance or as part of making new work.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: interpreting cultural frameworks in social and historical context
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to identify and interpret the cultural frameworks around performance events and how they relate to social and historical contexts.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to interpret, not only name, the cultural frameworks of performance events and link them to social and historical context.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to identify and interpret the cultural frameworks around a performance and how they link to its social and historical setting.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: critical and analytical argument
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to analyse critically when developing ideas and building arguments, and judge and present them in different ways.

forPractitioner.text: Expect critical, analytical development of ideas and arguments, judged and presented in several forms.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to develop ideas and arguments critically and analytically, and judge and present them in different ways.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: discourse and its effects on representation and reception
statements.paraphrase: Should show a developed ability to examine and evaluate kinds of discourse and their effects on how the arts and wider culture represent and are received.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to analyse how forms of discourse shape representation and reception in the arts and culture.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to examine and judge different kinds of discourse and how they shape representation and reception in the arts and culture.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: productive, creative group work on practice-based projects
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to work productively, creatively and imaginatively in a group, with the creative skills to carry out practice-based work.

forPractitioner.text: Expect productive, imaginative group work and the creative skills to complete practice-based projects.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to work productively and imaginatively in a group and have the creative skills to complete practical projects.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: workload, deadlines and goals with others
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to manage their own workload efficiently and effectively, meet deadlines, and agree and pursue goals with others successfully.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to manage their own workload, meet deadlines and negotiate and achieve goals with others.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to manage your own workload well, meet deadlines and agree and reach goals with others.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: managing creative and interpersonal issues constructively
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to manage creative, personal and interpersonal issues in creative work constructively and effectively.

forPractitioner.text: Expect constructive, effective handling of creative and interpersonal issues in group work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to deal constructively and effectively with creative, personal and interpersonal issues in creative work.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: independent information retrieval and critical evaluation
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to use information retrieval skills to gather, sift and organise material on their own and to judge its significance critically.

forPractitioner.text: Expect independent searching and organising of material, with critical judgement of its value.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to find, sift and organise material on your own and judge critically how much it matters.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: technological and digital skills and awareness
statements.paraphrase: Should show suitable technological and digital skills and a considerable awareness of how they apply and what they could do in the field.

forPractitioner.text: Expect sound digital skills and an informed view of how technology serves the field.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should have suitable technical and digital skills and a good sense of how they can be used in your field.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the typical rung
statements.about: choosing and applying numeracy skills
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to identify and apply a range of suitable numeracy skills to solve problems and achieve creative outcomes.

forPractitioner.text: Expect students to choose the right numeracy skills for practical and creative problems.

forBeneficiary.text: At the typical standard, you should be able to pick and use the right number skills to solve problems and make creative work happen.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated engagement with forms and traditions, interrogating them
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated engagement with performance's forms, practices, techniques, traditions, histories and applications, and the ability to interrogate them.

forPractitioner.text: Look for sophisticated engagement with the art form's forms, techniques, traditions and histories, interrogating them.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should engage with the forms, techniques, traditions and histories of performance in a sophisticated way and question them closely.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated engagement with components and making, leading to new insight
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated creative and theoretical engagement with performance's components and with how work is made, realised, managed, distributed, interpreted and recorded, producing new insight.

forPractitioner.text: Look for sophisticated creative and theoretical work across performance's components and a work's whole life, leading to fresh insight.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should work with the parts of a performance and the whole life of a work in a sophisticated creative and theoretical way that produces new insight.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated engagement with critical and theoretical perspectives
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated engagement with the critical and theoretical approaches suited to studying performance.

forPractitioner.text: Look for a sophisticated handling of the field's critical and theoretical approaches.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should handle critical and theoretical ways of studying performance in a sophisticated way.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: comprehensive, critical understanding of practitioners and contexts
statements.paraphrase: Should show a comprehensive and critical understanding of key practitioners, practices or theorists and their cultural or historical settings.

forPractitioner.text: Look for a comprehensive, critical grasp of key practitioners, practices or theorists in context.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should have a full and critical understanding of key practitioners, practices or theorists in their cultural or historical settings.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated engagement with the role of performance in society and industry
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated engagement with how performance functions in social, educational, participatory and industry settings.

forPractitioner.text: Look for sophisticated engagement with performance's place in communities, education, participation and industry.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should engage in a sophisticated way with what performance does in society, education, participatory work and the industry.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated understanding of critical and creative enquiry
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated understanding of how critical and creative enquiry interact in the field.

forPractitioner.text: Look for a sophisticated grasp of how critical and creative enquiry work together.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should have a sophisticated understanding of how critical thinking and creative making feed into each other.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated interpretation of texts, notations and scores
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated understanding of how to work with and interpret texts, media, dance notations or scores to make performance.

forPractitioner.text: Look for sophisticated interpretation of scripts, media, dance notation and scores as material for performance.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should understand in a sophisticated way how to read and interpret scripts, media, dance notation or scores to make performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated understanding and use of group processes
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated critical understanding of group processes and the ability to apply it.

forPractitioner.text: Look for a sophisticated critical grasp of group processes, shown in how students use them.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should understand group processes in a sophisticated, critical way and put that understanding to use.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated understanding of the elements of performance
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated critical understanding of the key elements of performance, such as sources, performers, the body, space, sound, text, movement and setting.

forPractitioner.text: Look for a sophisticated critical grasp of performance's elements, the body included.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should understand the building blocks of performance in a sophisticated, critical way, including the body, space, sound, text, movement and setting.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated understanding of interdisciplinary elements and other fields
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated critical understanding of suitable interdisciplinary elements of performance and of how to use ideas, methods and skills from other fields.

forPractitioner.text: Look for a sophisticated critical grasp of interdisciplinary elements and of drawing on other fields.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should understand in a sophisticated, critical way how ideas, methods and skills from other subjects can be used in performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: comprehensive understanding of safe, sustainable and ethical practice
statements.paraphrase: Should show comprehensive understanding of performance practitioners' duty to make working practice safe, environmentally sustainable and ethical.

forPractitioner.text: Look for a comprehensive grasp of the practitioner's duty to work safely, sustainably and ethically.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should have a full understanding of your duty to work safely, sustainably and ethically when making performance.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: thorough critical command of performance and production processes
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to handle performance and production processes with critical depth and thoroughness, choosing, refining and presenting them in performance.

forPractitioner.text: Look for critical, thorough command of performance and production processes in what students select, refine and present.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to handle performance and production processes with critical depth and thoroughness, choosing, refining and presenting them in your work.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: realising a text or score to make new or original work
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to work creatively and thoroughly with what a text, dance notation or score offers performance and, where suitable, realise it with sensitivity through design and performance, producing new or original work.

forPractitioner.text: Look for thorough, sensitive realisation of texts, notation or scores that leads to new or original work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to explore thoroughly and creatively what a script, notation or score offers and bring it to life with sensitivity, creating new or original work.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: making performance with a thorough grasp of its vocabularies
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to work creatively and comprehensively on making or producing performance, with a developed and thorough grasp of suitable vocabularies, techniques, crafts, structures and working methods.

forPractitioner.text: Look for creative, comprehensive making or production backed by a thorough command of the field's vocabularies and methods.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to make or produce performance creatively and comprehensively, with a thorough grasp of the techniques, crafts and working methods involved.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: critical, comprehensive independent research towards new insight
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to carry out suitable independent research critically and comprehensively, into past or present performance or within the making of new or novel work or insight.

forPractitioner.text: Look for thorough, critical independent research that yields new performance or new insight.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to research on your own critically and thoroughly, whether into past or present performance or as part of creating new work or ideas.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: critical investigation of cultural frameworks in context
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to identify and interpret, through critical investigation, the cultural frameworks around performance events and their particular social and historical settings.

forPractitioner.text: Look for critical investigation that identifies and interprets the cultural frameworks of performance events in their social and historical settings.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to investigate critically the cultural frameworks around a performance and interpret them in their social and historical setting.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: sophisticated creative and analytical argument
statements.paraphrase: Should show sophisticated creative and analytical skill in developing and building arguments, and be able to judge and present them in different ways.

forPractitioner.text: Look for sophisticated creative and analytical argument, judged and presented in several forms.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to develop arguments with sophisticated creative and analytical skill, and judge and present them in different ways.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: critical analysis of discourse and representation
statements.paraphrase: Should show a developed critical ability to examine and evaluate kinds of discourse and how they shape representation in the arts and wider culture.

forPractitioner.text: Look for developed critical analysis of how discourse shapes representation in the arts and culture.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to examine and judge, critically and in depth, how kinds of discourse shape representation in the arts and culture.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: productive, creative group work
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to work in a group productively, creatively and imaginatively.

forPractitioner.text: Look for productive, imaginative contributions to group work.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to work in a group productively, creatively and imaginatively.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: workload, deadlines and shared goals
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to manage their own workload efficiently and effectively, meet deadlines, and agree and pursue shared goals with others.

forPractitioner.text: Look for efficient self-management and skilled negotiation of shared goals.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to manage your own workload very well, meet deadlines and agree and work towards shared goals with others.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: managing creative, artistic and interpersonal issues
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to manage creative, artistic, personal and interpersonal issues constructively and effectively.

forPractitioner.text: Look for constructive, effective handling of creative, artistic and interpersonal issues.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to deal constructively and effectively with creative, artistic, personal and interpersonal issues.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: discerning information retrieval and synthesis
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to use discerning information retrieval skills to gather, sift, synthesise and organise material on their own and to judge its significance critically.

forPractitioner.text: Look for discerning searching, synthesis and critical judgement of material.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to find, sift, combine and organise material with discernment on your own and judge critically how much it matters.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: digital skills and full awareness of their potential
statements.paraphrase: Should show suitable technical and digital skills and full awareness of what they could be used for.

forPractitioner.text: Look for strong digital skills and a full grasp of their possible uses.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should have suitable technical and digital skills and be fully aware of how they could be used.

statements.appliesTo: honours graduates in Performance at the excellent rung
statements.about: deploying numeracy for creative outputs
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to identify and use several numeracy skills to solve problems and achieve creative outputs.

forPractitioner.text: Look for confident choice and use of numeracy in practical and creative problems.

forBeneficiary.text: At the excellent standard, you should be able to choose and use a range of number skills to solve problems and produce creative work.

forPractitioner.text: Expect critical evaluation of current research and scholarship, applied with originality.

forBeneficiary.text: By the end of your master's degree, you should be able to evaluate current research and advanced scholarship and use what you know in original ways.

statements.paraphrase: Should be able to evaluate suitable methods and show self-direction and originality in tackling complex problems in practice or research.

forBeneficiary.text: By the end of your master's degree, you should be able to weigh up methods and tackle complex problems in practice or research on your own initiative and in original ways.

statements.about: new insight communicated to all audiences
statements.paraphrase: Should be able to create new insight in their field and communicate conclusions clearly to specialists and non-specialists.

forPractitioner.text: Expect new insight and clear communication of conclusions to specialist and general audiences.

forBeneficiary.text: By the end of your master's degree, you should be able to create new insight in your field and explain your conclusions clearly to experts and non-experts.
